observed_environment_constraints.scope: One independently verified closed trial; not an aggregate count or controlled parallel performance baseline.
observed_environment_constraints.race_arm_interpretation: Observed adaptive race workflow, including dynamic serial backpressure fallback.
observed_environment_constraints.limitation: Arm name alone does not prove concurrent generation. Earlier rounded load26.0 exceeds24.0; the serial branch samples load again and its exact sample is unknown. Do not infer scheduling for every race, host cause from physical CPU counts, or pure parallel speedup.

observer_v1_side_effect.scope: Early observerV1 setup side effect; subsequent corrected observer trial configuration is private.
observer_v1_side_effect.cause: Configuration initialized before HOME isolation in the early observer.
observer_v1_side_effect.limitation: The original content is unknown. This report does not claim restoration or that default HOME was never written. Directory metadata changed; its source is not inferred.

formal96.scope: Only96 formal trials; descriptive fixed fixtures, not general model superiority or a subscription invoice.

cost_accounting.scope: Accounting only across calibration and formal phases; quality/time populations remain separate. Failed dispatches remain included.
cost_accounting.reason: Go CLI usage/cost is uninstrumented; missed CLI records remain unknown. Claude client estimates and Codex scenario estimates are different sources, never added into a measured bill.

go_cli_demonstration.scope: Both Go demonstrations are excluded from96 and calibration comparison. Current V4 uses600seconds and no-auto-fix, different from formal240seconds.

definitions.time: WallP50/P95 use nearest-rank quantiles, not the arithmetic midpoint median for an even sample. All-trial and accepted-only populations differ; adapter workflow and external acceptance are not nested-span sums.
definitions.paired_time: Paired wall medians use statistics.median only on matched cases/repeats that both arms passed, not all trials; this survivor subset is not an overall speedup estimate.
definitions.uncertainty: Twelve fixed fixtures with two repeats per arm support descriptive comparisons only. The analyzer uses bootstrap_repetitions=0, so bootstrap interval fields remain null; no population confidence interval is claimed.
definitions.cost: All failed attempts remain in numerators. Zero accepted deliveries yields null cost-per-delivery.
definitions.coverage: Complete token totals stay null unless coverage is complete; observed subtotals and missing counts remain visible.
definitions.estimates: Claude CLI reported API estimate and Codex short/long conditional API tariffs are not subscription or marginal cash bills.
definitions.race_scheduling: The observed race arm includes load-driven serial fallback. Its name does not establish uniform concurrent generation or pure parallel acceleration; total dispatch capacity is not an in-flight slot limit.
definitions.comparison: Only96 fixed trials are compared; pilot stages and separate Go demonstrations with a600-second workflow guard are excluded, with no pooled success/latency statistic.
